spans.text: fear conditioning task

description.value: Three visual stimuli were presented 10 times each in pseudorandomized order. One conditioned stimulus was paired with a shock on every trial, one on 60% of trials, and one safety stimulus was never paired with a shock. Behavioral shock-expectancy ratings were collected before, during, and after conditioning.

design_type.value: Fear conditioning paradigm with repeated-measures stimulus and time structure

stimuli.value: Three colored squares; mild electric shocks delivered to the right wrist through MR-compatible gold electrodes.

value: Behavioral shock-expectancy ratings from 0% to 100% collected before, during, and after conditioning
